source.directorySummary: Implements the `upload` subcommand for the file plugin, defining its CLI metadata and handling the full pipeline of validating arguments, resolving workspace-relative paths, and encrypting files for Blossom upload with NIP-44 key sharing and publishing a replaceable Nostr file event.

adapter.ts.sourceSummary: Adapter extracts string filePath and recipientNpub from params.parsed.arguments and delegates to handleUploadCommand with prefix/alias, returning result.text for usage/error/success cases.

definition.ts.sourceSummary: Defines uploadDefinition factory returning SubcommandDefinition named 'upload' with summary about Blossom + NIP-17 encryption, optional filePath and recipientNpub string arguments, and example invocations.

handler.ts.sourceSummary: Handler validates filePathArg and recipientNpub presence, resolves absolute path via resolveFileWorkspaceRoot, loads Nostr config, invokes fileUpload, and formats usage, skipped-hash, success, or error text with filename and naddr.

sync.ts.sourceSummary: Implements fileUpload that decodes recipient npub, reads file and SHA-256 hashes plaintext, checks existing FILE_KIND event for hash-match skip or prev divergence, AES-GCM encrypts with random key/nonce, uploads ciphertext blob to Blossom, NIP-44 encrypts the AES key for the recipient, and publishes the tagged Nostr event returning filename, naddr, and skipped.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Outbound leaf of the secure-transfer pair (complement to download) within the file plugin's command aggregation. Operates as a dispatched leaf beneath adapter.ts/handleFile and init.ts registration, reusing the shared workspace-containment validation before executing the encrypt-upload-publish chain. Provides the workspace-to-recipient direction of the Nostr/Blossom NIP-44 flow with hash-based deduplication via replaceable FILE_KIND events, which download reverses.

files.adapter.ts: CLI/web adaptation shim for the centralized dispatcher pattern — extracts typed arguments and threads prefix/alias through to the handler, isolating transport formatting (result.text) from validation and transfer logic consistent with all 20 file commands.
files.definition.ts: Declarative registration artifact consumed by the file plugin's command aggregation and help system — defines the subcommand contract (name, summary, arguments, examples) without owning execution, enabling discovery and routing via the parent container.
files.handler.ts: Orchestration and boundary-validation layer between adapter and core logic — enforces argument presence, resolves workspace containment via resolveFileWorkspaceRoot, loads Nostr config, delegates to fileUpload, and maps skipped/success/error outcomes to user-facing text with filename and naddr.
files.sync.ts: Core domain engine for the outbound encrypted transfer — owns the hash-check deduplication against existing replaceable Nostr events, AES-GCM file encryption, Blossom ciphertext upload, NIP-44 key wrapping for the recipient, and tagged event publication.
